commands: Telegram /voice QUESTION: audio only on success; text fallback
Telegram /voice: read the latest successful answer as audio; text fallback
Telegram text request: generate/select images for actual photo attachment
Telegram /cron create: sequential name/task/when/repeat/preview/Confirm after coordinator wiring
Telegram /cancel: cancel own active UX draft
Telegram /new: locally permitted fresh shared conversation with explicit Confirm and execution guard

inputs: job mapping with id and prompt; optional existing chat/user fields
outputs: status succeeded or failed and response text; exact native session retained

storage.namespace: Bot/project outputs Telegram state; media.sqlite3 and media/<job>/ snapshots separate from jobs DB; optional credentials at XDG_CONFIG_HOME/senai/voice/<project-hash>.json outside project/Git
storage.migration_notes: Additive independent uploads and voice_requests tables in media.sqlite3; existing Telegram jobs/users/sessions/cursors and text delivery_snapshots retained. No legacy data deletion. Optional version-1 protected voice JSON lives outside the project/Git, separate from Telegram credentials; no database migration. Additive voice_delivery(job_id,outcome) table in media.sqlite3 records audio/fallback decisions; existing jobs/media/text cursors and protected voice JSON untouched. Separate mode-600 conversations.sqlite3 namespace/drafts tables; existing sessions table reused for explicit telegram-history:<UUID> archived pointers. No new Telegram columns/deletion; old jobs/pairing/media/profile snapshots preserved.

shared_file_changes: Coordinator cron_runtime/Telegram startup: compose ConversationRouter outside legacy cron handler; pass cron parser and authorized creator.
Coordinator startup context: freeze installation/project/timezone; pass installation to both CommandRunner instances.
Coordinator runtime: one SessionGate around foreground and cron runners, scheduler idle predicate and explicit local /new operator allowlist.
sibling_requirements: Cron parse_schedule(when, repeat, *, now: aware datetime, timezone) -> dict with aware future at, optional matching timezone/every int/cron; reject ambiguous date/year/DST.

limitations: Ready means feature-owned module review, not completed coordinator UX deployment. Natural-language parser/composition remains pending.
/new is disabled unless local operator policy and execution guard are explicitly supplied; guard must cover cron/foreground and scheduler pending/uncertain states.
No live bot restart, API/model calls, real schedules, production state or push/merge performed.
Separate queue/draft writes can lose a field transition after a crash; persisted creation claim avoids automatic duplicate creation and may require /cron list review.
Existing voice/media external-acceptance ambiguities remain; no exactly-once remote delivery guarantee.
Uncertain confirmation receipts require explicit review/cancellation instead of normal timeout; cancellation does not undo a possibly completed action.
delivery_scope: Feature-owned guided Telegram cron conversation, safe explicit fresh-session policy, existing voice/media retention and pinned-memory hook; coordinator composes runtime.
external_services: Optional OpenAI Speech API: dedicated env key, saved protected voice file, then generic OpenAI env key; local setup/check makes no network call.
Installed Codex built-in image generation when available; no image API client/key added

coordinator_integration.cli_conflict_resolution: Protected voice loading plus existing bounded cron/session and independent delivery hooks
